header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Aziz Ahmed Laghari advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Neel Parkash Deputy Prosecutor General Sindh.
body: Learned counsel for the applicant after arguing the matter at some length submits that he will not press the instant Criminal Misc. Application, if the learned trial Court is directed to conclude the trial within shortest period such proposal has not been opposed by learned D.P.G.

In view of the above, the instant Criminal Misc. Application is disposed of with directions to the learned trial Court to decide the case within a period of ninety (90) days and furnish such report through Additional Registrar of this Court.
